text_block_list.text:
While walking through the shopping district with Yaeno Muteki
at lunchtime—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes, while the flavor is impressive on its own,
the real highlight is apparently the 'portion size'.
Supposedly they have a rather quirky system...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Look at this!
'Mega-Portion Dan Rank Certification Exam'!
Apparently you're awarded a rank based on how much you finish!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I see, reaching the 10th dan with this amount...
And above that, there's even full mastery...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"That's a tremendous amount, but hearing that it leads
to full mastery makes me itch for action.
May I give it a try?"
choice_data_list: Moderation is key when it comes to meals, you know!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, that is right.
This is a meal, not a test of strength."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'm curious about the rank certification, but...
Osu, I'd better pass...!

And so, I managed to keep Yaeno Muteki
from overeating.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Ossu! No matter the path,
there must be truths revealed once it is mastered."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: To open a new door, I shall rise to the challenge!

Afterward, Yaeno Muteki pushed past her stomach's
limits and earned full mastery of the craft.
